purpose: Causally separate q90, qi, qH and moving-boundary geometric-transfer contributions to one-observation-interval teacher error by surgical Reference-oracle substitution, without proposing a deployable closure.

regime_partition.source: categorical prescribed-H histories frozen before C4B response
regime_partition.note: No magnitude threshold or state-error statistic defines the regime partition.

model_policy.start_state: exact A2 Reference-projected reduced state at every observation interval
model_policy.prescribed_H: exact A2 H(t) over the interval

reference_interval_oracles.q90_ref: exact interval-average q90 recursively diagnosed from Reference fixed-layer storage change with zero top flux
reference_interval_oracles.qi_ref: exact interval-average qi from the split moving-control-volume Reference ledger
reference_interval_oracles.qH_ref: exact interval-average lower-boundary flux from Reference bottom exchange
reference_interval_oracles.Gi_ref: exact interval-average moving-boundary internal transfer, dWb_ref/dt - q90_ref + qi_ref
reference_interval_oracles.use: When a channel is oracle-selected, its instantaneous C0 contribution is replaced throughout the substeps by the constant exact Reference interval-average value. This is diagnostic and not a candidate closure.

intervention_algebra.q90: replace q90 in the last-fixed/Wb conservative transfer pair only
intervention_algebra.qi: replace qi in the Wb/Wt conservative transfer pair only
intervention_algebra.qH: replace qH in Wt and cumulative bottom exchange consistently
intervention_algebra.Gi: replace theta_i*Hdot by Gi_ref in the Wb/Wt moving-boundary transfer pair while retaining total theta_s*Hdot geometry exactly
intervention_algebra.conservation: Internal q90, qi and Gi oracle substitutions are pairwise conservative. qH remains the only oracle that changes total unsaturated storage.

metrics_per_variant_case_route: RMS and max mass-neutral physical-state shape error at interval end
RMS and max total unsaturated-storage error
RMS Wb error and Wt error
cumulative vector sum of one-interval physical-state errors over the history
mass-neutral shape norm of that cumulative vector at final geometry
relative reduction of each error component versus BASE_C0, reported but not thresholded

HOLD_Q90.rule: ORACLE_Q90 must be the unique best single-channel oracle by cumulative mass-neutral shape norm at both widths and both internal-dt routes to support Q90_CAUSAL_IN_HOLD.

MONOTONE_QI.rule: ORACLE_QI must be the unique best single-channel oracle among Q90, QI, QH and GI in all four width × {RISE,FALL} cases on both routes to support QI_CAUSAL_IN_MONOTONE_H_MOTION.

CYCLE_QH.rule: ORACLE_QH must be the unique best single-channel oracle in both width × CYCLE cases on both routes to support QH_CAUSAL_IN_CYCLE_CUMULATIVE_SHAPE.

COUPLED_QI_QH.rule: ORACLE_QI_QH is reported as coupled diagnostic. It may establish COUPLED_LOWER_INTERFACE_CAUSALITY only if it is strictly better than both ORACLE_QI and ORACLE_QH in every dynamic case on both routes. It cannot rescue a failed single-channel hypothesis.

adjudication: Report every case/route ranking; no majority fallback replaces the frozen unanimity rules.
If monotone and cycle causal families differ, close as REGIME_DEPENDENT_COUPLED_LOWER_BOUNDARY_CAUSALITY and do not create a global correction.
If no frozen causal hypothesis passes, close as MULTI_CHANNEL_OR_SUBINTERVAL_DYNAMICS_REQUIRED.
HOLD is an equilibrium control and cannot select a dynamic correction.
next_step_rule: Any candidate physical closure change after C4B requires a new preregistration and must target only the causally supported regime/channel structure. Oracle values themselves may never enter a deployable model.

pre_execution_adjudication_clarification.single_channel_ranking: For each case/route, rank ORACLE_Q90, ORACLE_QI, ORACLE_QH and ORACLE_GI by ascending cumulative mass-neutral shape norm. UNIQUE_BEST means exactly one minimum; no effect-size tolerance is introduced.

decision_map.REGIME_DEPENDENT_COUPLED_LOWER_BOUNDARY_: MONOTONE_QI and CYCLE_QH both pass their frozen unanimity rules; HOLD_Q90 is reported independently and is not required for this dynamic decision.
decision_map.MULTI_CHANNEL_OR_SUBINTERVAL_DYNAMICS_RE: Both MONOTONE_QI and CYCLE_QH fail their frozen unanimity rules.
decision_map.C4B_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any required case/route is incomplete, nonfinite, outside constitutive domain, or violates a hard gate.

pre_execution_adjudication_clarification.coupled_QI_QH_role: COUPLED_QI_QH is an independent supporting diagnostic. It does not change the single-channel decision map and cannot rescue a failed MONOTONE_QI or CYCLE_QH hypothesis.
pre_execution_adjudication_clarification.scientific_effect: Makes the preregistered decision tree exhaustive only. Regimes, variants, metrics, cases and causal hypotheses are unchanged.
